close_reason:
Propagated the field-addition policy + with_* setters pattern to all three sibling extension-server Result types identified in scope:

1. crate-jmap-calendars-server CalendarEventParseResult: derived Default, added with_parsed/with_not_found/with_not_parsable, doc Field-addition policy on new() citing ChatLimits.
2. crate-jmap-calendars-server SetDefaultResult: added with_new_default/with_previous_default setters, doc Field-addition policy on new() citing ChatLimits.
3. crate-jmap-chat-server OpResult: added with_op_index/with_outcome setters, doc Field-addition policy hoisted to type-level rustdoc (constructors are named ok/err, not new, so the policy is documented above the struct).

Quality gates pass on both affected crates: fmt + clippy --all-features --tests + test --all-features + doc --all-features. 10 new unit tests (3 default-is-empty + 2 new-populates + 5 with_setters across the three types).

Did NOT modify the in-crate trait default impl in CalendarsBackend::parse_calendar_event_blobs that constructs CalendarEventParseResult via struct-literal syntax (line 610). #[non_exhaustive] permits intra-crate struct-literal construction; the policy applies to external crates. Leaving the default impl unchanged keeps scope tight.
description:
JMAP-q2wa.22 reshaped jmap-mail-server's MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult to follow the workspace canonical pattern for #[non_exhaustive] types with builder setters:

1. Derive Default
2. Keep new(positional_current_fields) stable across the crate's lifetime
3. Add #[must_use] with_<field>(self, value) -> Self setters per field
4. Doc 'Field-addition policy' section explaining: future fields default to Default and are exposed via with_* setters; new() never gains positional args.
5. Test coverage: default-is-empty + new-populates-fields + with_setters-replace-fields per type.

The canonical (mail-server) is now updated. Per the canonical-template propagation rule, the same shape must be applied to sibling extension-server Result types that today have the same fragile new(all_fields) shape:

**In scope:**
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/backend.rs::CalendarEventParseResult — line ~782, has new(parsed, not_found, not_parsable). Explicitly cites MdnParseResult as the precedent (line 777). Apply: derive Default, add with_parsed/with_not_found/with_not_parsable, doc field-addition policy.
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/backend.rs::SetDefaultResult — line ~823. Already derives Default. Add with_new_default/with_previous_default setters and the field-addition-policy doc.
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs::OpResult — line ~61, has ok(op_index, id) / err(op_index, error) named constructors. Different shape from Mdn*Result (named ok/err constructors instead of new(all_fields)). Field-addition concern is the same (adding audit_log_handle: Option<...> would force a third positional arg to both). Apply: derive Default if sensible, add with_* setters, doc field-addition policy. Note that the doc framing must reflect the named-constructor shape (ok/err stay stable; future fields default via with_*).

**Out of scope:**
- AvailabilityError (enum, not struct)
- jmap-mail-types::mdn::Mdn — already has Mdn::new(disposition) which is a single required-arg constructor; field additions naturally stay non-breaking. No reshape needed.
- Sibling extension-server *MockBackend* or *FaultyBackend* test wrappers — internal test scaffolding.

**Verification per sibling:**
- cargo fmt --all
- cargo clippy -p <crate> --all-features --tests -- -D warnings
- cargo test -p <crate> --all-features
- RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps -p <crate> --all-features

Parent epic: JMAP-q2wa.
